sales_tax_note: Sales tax (Minnesota): digital goods are taxable as digital products (courses, downloads, prewritten software); subscriptions that only use online-hosted software and custom software fees are not; services are generally outside Minnesota sales tax unless specifically enumerated — confirm your mix with MN Revenue before collecting. Remote sellers: register after 200+ retail sales or $100,000+ into Minnesota over 12 months; an operator based in Minnesota registers from the start.
tax_disclaimer: Not tax advice — verify with MN Revenue.
